|lore=Enclosed. Chewie’s daring capture of an Imperial AT-ST helped turn the tide in the Battle of Endor.
|game_text=May add 2 pilots. During battle, if Chewie aboard, may target an opponent’s character or AT-ST present. Draw destiny. Target hit and power = 0 if destiny > defense value. Immune to attrition < 4.

|notes=The recovered original Players Committee sheet is linked from the [[Chewie's AT-ST (V) (Virtual Set 9: Sanctuary Moon) (Original 2005)|2005 publication]]. The earlier slip lets Chewie deploy free, takes pilots or passengers, and makes attrition immunity conditional on Chewie being aboard. The later slip requires Chewie for the hit action, drops its Force activation and changes deploy 4 to 2 and forfeit 6 to 5. 
|sources=* [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards9.pdf#page=2 VirtualCards9.pdf] (Players Committee Remaster sheet, starwarsccg.org CDN; the swccgpc.com copy was captured by the Internet Archive on 24 October 2007) — official text as of 4 December 2006 (errata to card #10 on 17 September 2007); page 2, slip 02.
